note: A SCRATCH catalogue, not the main one. It exists to answer the single question F028 left open: R4's proof perimeter is five Gobra-verified packages, R5's refinement perimeter is four clause-carrying files, and the only file between them is internal/dom/dom.go -- but the main catalogue has no mutant confined to that file, so the two columns agreed on all 18 cells without ever being given a chance to disagree. These two mutants are confined to internal/dom/dom.go and to nothing else. They are deliberately NOT in tools/cmd/mutate/mutants.json: the ids there are shared across all four corners so the kill table can compare a defect port-to-port, and a Go-only id would break that symmetry and shift every published denominator to settle a question about one rung pair. Run with `calibrate -manifest evidence/experiments/r4-r5-separation/manifest.json -impls go -rungs R4,R5`.

families.validation: observable input validation inside the verified core: the handle alphabet (D1) and the text character range (D6). Both are proved in internal/dom/dom.go by a loop invariant that cannot be restated in the postcondition, so they are obligations R4 can see and the refinement clause list cannot.

mutants.description: ValidHandle accepts the byte range A..z instead of a..z, so uppercase handles and the punctuation between Z and a ([, \, ], ^, `) are admitted -- handle "Alice" registers. Breaks the third loop invariant of ValidHandle, which is the only place the alphabet property is proved.

ValidText drops the control-character guard, so a tweet body containing a NUL or a newline is accepted and echoed back. Breaks the third loop invariant of ValidText, which is the only place the character-range property is proved.
